_doc: Mapping from RINDA weekly larval source management indicators to DHIS2 / HMIS data elements. Every UID is a placeholder until the RBC HMIS team supplies the data set, data elements and organisation units. While any UID is UNMAPPED, exports are marked mapping_pending and a DHIS2 import will reject them, which is intended.
status: PENDING - data set, data element and organisation unit UIDs to be supplied by the RBC HMIS team
